topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I was sifting through the university’s admissions website, looking for any tips or guidance for prospective applicants, when I stumbled upon something I hadn’t expected. There it was, my words, my college application essay, displayed under a section titled “Sample Essays.” Each phrase, every argument, was unmistakably mine. I leaned back, my eyes scanning over the familiar lines, the precise reasoning and personal anecdotes that I had poured my heart into. It felt like a part of me was being shared, yet there was a peculiar sense of exposure and a newfound weight to those words now that they were out in the open, guiding others.
